scripts.dev:update: cross-env AXIAM_DEV_FAKE_UPDATE=1 AXIAM_DEV_FAKE_WHATS_NEW=1 npm run dev
scripts.dev:showcase: cross-env AXIAM_DEV_SHOWCASE=1 AXIAM_DEV_FAKE_WHATS_NEW=1 npm run dev
scripts.build:linux: npm run build:electron && vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.build:mutex-closer: cd tools/mutex-closer && cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu && cp target/x86_64-pc-windows-gnu/release/axiam-mutex-closer.exe ../../build/win/axiam-mutex-closer.exe
scripts.build:local-dat-redirect: cd tools/local-dat-redirect && cargo build --release && cd ../.. && node scripts/copy-native-artifact.mjs tools/local-dat-redirect/target/release/axiam_local_dat_redirect.dll axiam_local_dat_redirect.dll
scripts.build:injector: cd tools/injector && cargo build --release && cd ../.. && node scripts/copy-native-artifact.mjs tools/injector/target/release/axiam-injector.exe axiam-injector.exe
scripts.build:native: npm run build:mutex-closer && npm run build:local-dat-redirect && npm run build:injector
scripts.build:win: npm run build:electron && vite build && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:all: npm run build:electron && vite build && electron-builder --linux --win
scripts.shots:marketing: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/take-marketing-screenshots.mjs
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:electron && vite build && electron-builder
